releases.title: Photo search, interpreter, health imports, captions, action timeline, privacy ledger, legacy access

items.text: What left this server (Settings → Privacy & system → Privacy): a day-by-day list of every request her server sent to another computer, grouped by why it went.
Caregiver mode (Health → Daily check-in, Caregivers, Simple home): a person can let an adult in their household see their missed doses, their daily check-ins, or both.
Accessibility switch (Settings → You → Appearance → Accessibility, also a quick setting on the Settings home): one switch for easier reading.
Action timeline (Settings → Privacy & system → Reports → Action timeline): one list of what she changed for you, newest first, for 90 days: files.
Legacy and emergency access (Settings → Privacy & system → Privacy): name one person you trust and pick what they get.
Live and translated captions for meetings (Library → Meetings → a meeting → Captions): big captions that follow a room or a recording while she hears it.

releases.title: My apps, automation replay, workforce report, Fix this issue, website receptionist

items.text: Automation steps and replay (Settings → You → Automations): Steps opens an automation's step list.
Workforce report and one-click hire: once a week.
Fix this issue (Settings → Connections → Apps and services → GitHub → Fix an issue): a repository's open issues, each with one button.
My apps (Library → My apps): ask her for a small web app in a chat, try it and say "keep it".
Website receptionist (Settings → You → Business details → Website receptionist): a chat for your own website, added with one line of code.

releases.title: Renewals, purchases, Home Assistant scenes, audio briefing, scan pages, upkeep, gifts

items.text: Car and house upkeep (Settings → You → My details → Car and house upkeep): add the usual schedule for a car.
Gifts and occasions: each People card now shows the next birthday and yearly dates, a gift budget, gift ideas from what she knows.
One-minute voice journal: Library → Journal. Pick how today was, press Record a minute and talk (or type it), and the entry is saved with its mood.
Find a time with a friend: in a one-to-one Messages chat (or by asking her, "find a time with Sam for coffee").
Snap and file: Library → Scan pages takes pages with the phone or computer camera (or photos you already have), finds the paper's edges.
Morning briefing as audio (Settings → You → Briefing and reminders → Listen to your briefing).

releases.title: Bring everything, Waiting on you, Where do you text?, cost autopilot

items.text: Benchmark page: Sara's original coding tasks can now run through other agent CLIs you installed yourself.
Cost autopilot (Settings → Models & usage → Which model does what): a quality bar per job (talking, coding and long tasks, web research). *Best* never switches.
Where do you text?: a picker at the top of Settings → Connections → Apps and services.
Waiting on you, one list: everything that needs your answer.
Move in with one button: each old agent Sara finds on this computer has Bring everything: one review that counts her personality, notes, chats, skills, scheduled jobs.

releases.title: Sign in with your provider, faster voice on Windows, store-ready extension

items.text: Sign in with your provider (OpenID Connect) on every server, not only business mode.
Stopping Sara (the Windows service closing her input) could wait for a backup tick's test restore or weekly check; the stop now skips that maintenance.

releases.title: Security review, backup test restores, What's new, server dashboard, faster voice

items.text: A monthly test restore that proves backups work.
What's new after each update. The first time you open Sara after an update, a short page lists what changed in each release since the version you last saw.

releases.title: Talk with Sara, shared projects, marketplace, picture studio, business pack

items.text: A Business place in the sidebar that brings clients, time, invoices and quotes together.
Picture editing and short video on your own computer with ComfyUI.
Shared projects between linked friends. On a project page, Shared with friends invites one or more friends whose Sara is linked under Messages, as Can view or Can edit.
Shared by friends, a community marketplace. In a Messages community or with a linked friend, share skills, templates, automations.
Talk with Sara. One button next to the message box starts a hands-free conversation in the browser, the desktop apps and the phone web app: she listens all the time.

releases.title: Settings and the new windows open again

items.text: In 3.22.0, Settings, Health, Family and every window after Money opened empty.
